messages:
mike: Heads-up: Partner 'EdgeSensors' ingested a big negative delta spike in last night's billing rollup. Looks like thousands of units disappeared between 02:00-03:00 UTC. Can someone with metering context take a look?

tara: i'm pulling the raw events now. do you have an example event_id?

mike: grabbed one from the reconciler: evt_cs_33421. summary: cumulative_counter dropped from 1,240,000 to 15,000 after device reboot. our pipeline treats incoming "counter_value" as incremental if there's a monotonic increase, else we compute delta = new - last. negative delta -> we cap to 0 currently, which caused underreporting.

zhen: aha. EdgeSensors devices send cumulative total ticks per sensor, but when devices reboot they reset to 0. that means we should detect reset and use new_value (post-reset) as delta, not zero. current logic ignores negative deltas.

tara: sample payload: ```
{
  "event_id": "evt_cs_33421",
  "device_id": "es-77-34",
  "partner_id": "edgesensors",
  "counter_value": 15000,
  "prev_counter_value": 1240000,
  "event_ts": "2026-11-05T02:15:03Z"
}
```

mike: the device log shows a reboot at 02:14:58 and then resumed. we should treat prev_counter_value as stale if timestamp gap > 5m or prev > new by > 50%.

zhen: agreed. recommended logic: if new >= prev -> delta = new - prev; else if new < prev and (prev - new) > RESET_THRESHOLD -> delta = new (assume counter reset); else if time_gap > GAP_THRESHOLD -> treat as reset and delta = new. defaults: RESET_THRESHOLD = 0.5 * prev (or 100%?) and GAP_THRESHOLD = 300s. We should also record a flag on the ledger row: "counter_reset_detected": true.

tara: downstream ramifications: finance expects usage continuity. If we switch logic retrospectively, we need to backfill the missing deltas for last 30 days for affected devices. how many devices impacted? query running.

ops-bot: query result: 1,142 devices with at least one negative delta in past 30 days; total undercount estimated ~2.3M units.

emma: finance here. 2.3M units is material for partner settlement. We'll need an audit trail and partner agreement to apply corrections. Can we produce a per-device reconciliation file with before/after numbers?

mike: yes — plan: 1) patch ingestion to handle resets (non-breaking), 2) run a historical backfill that recalculates deltas for events with negative deltas in 30-day window and write corrections to backfill-ledger with audit metadata, 3) produce CSV for finance+partner listing device_id, window, old_billed, new_billed, reason.

zhen: implementation note: change in ingest service is single-file: MeteringDeltaCalculator.v2. Add heuristics and an enum reason: [MONOTONIC, RESET_DETECTED, GAP_INFERRED, DUP_SUPPRESSION]. We should also emit metric counter: meter.reset_detected.count.

tara: i started a job to sample the top 200 devices by undercount to validate heuristics. initial preview shows for 80% of cases the reset logic would recover expected usage.

emma: partner legal: do we have an SLA clause allowing retroactive adjustments? account team will confirm. Meanwhile please include an opt-in flag when sending corrections to partner; finance wants partner approval before final settlement changes.

mike: ok. also, we should reach out to EdgeSensors engineering: suggest they send a "boot_id" or monotonic sequence number so we can detect resets reliably instead of heuristics. recommend header x-device-boot-id or include in payload.

zhen: agree. push a short note with example payload and recommended fields: boot_id, uptime_seconds, monotonic_counter. that'll reduce backfill risk.

tara: for the backfill runtime: estimated 2h to rewrite 30 days for affected devices at current cluster throughput; will write results to backfill-ledger and tag entries with source_patch: "metering-reset-heuristic-20261105".

emma: finance request: include a consolidated impact summary and per-partner CSV by EOD Friday so we can coordinate settlement. also include audit hashes for ledger rows.

mike: owners: zhen -> ingestion patch + metrics, tara -> backfill run + CSV export, emma -> partner + finance coordination, mike -> partner outreach & runbook. target: staging patch tomorrow, backfill in staging to validate, production rollback plan ready.

ops-bot: deploy created: branches/ingest/metering-reset-heuristic -> canary (ingest-canary)

zhen: running unit tests now. also adding reconciliation testcases: device reboot in middle of window, duplicate events, out-of-order arrival.

emma: ping once you have the sample CSV so I can check the format with finance.

mike: posting the runbook draft in #partnerships-runbooks after CI passes. will @mention EdgeSensors PM for scheduling a quick sync.

tara: sampling job done. sending sample CSV to emma via DM. includes columns: device_id, window_start, old_billed, new_billed, delta, reason.

emma: received. looks good. forwarding to finance and account team.

zhen: canary LGTM. metrics show meter.reset_detected.count=1142 in test window. no significant latency impact.

mike: proceeding to schedule staging backfill. will update thread with partner outreach note.

ops-bot: backfill started: backfill-ledger.rewrite_job_8821 -> ETA 2h.

mike: marking this thread tracked. reopen if partner needs data or disputes items. :white_check_mark:
